about.title: We had to rename the company. We kept going.
text: We started the business in April of 2009 as Beacon Electrical Service. Nearly a year later we learned another company had reserved that name in Texas, and in March of 2010 we chose the name ProLectric.

In August of 2013 we moved from a home office into a 2000 square foot office building in Dickinson. In 2018 our son came to work full time after high school, earned his Journeyman's license in 2022 and is studying for his master license.
We pay for all the training and licensing our electricians need, and our phones are answered live.

sameDay: Same day electrical service is usually available for commercial and residential customers.

faqs.q: Do you have an electrician near me?
faqs.a: ProLectric provides electrical services across the Bay Area Houston region, with licensed electricians based throughout Dickinson, League City and Alvin. We can frequently offer same-day service for urgent repairs.

faqs.q: Can I add a new outlet to an existing circuit?
faqs.a: Yes, but it must be done safely to avoid overloading the circuit. Our master electricians can evaluate your current load and install a new outlet that meets modern building codes, including GFCI protection where required.

faqs.q: Why won't my GFCI outlet reset?
faqs.a: It is usually due to a ground fault, or the outlet itself has failed. First check your main breaker panel. If the breaker is on, the outlet may need professional replacement.

faqs.q: Does ProLectric give free estimates for electrical work?
faqs.a: We offer free estimates for new electrical additions and replacements, such as adding outlets, installing EV chargers, or panel additions and upgrades. Free estimates do not apply to troubleshooting, repair calls, or panel replacements/change-outs; for repairs we give a clear price before work begins.

faqs.q: Why does my circuit breaker keep tripping?
faqs.a: Usually an overloaded circuit, a short circuit, or a ground fault. If it trips repeatedly, do not keep resetting it; a licensed electrician should inspect the circuit.

faqs.q: When should I replace my electrical panel?
faqs.a: Consider it if your home is over 20 years old, if you are adding high-power appliances like an EV charger, or if you have a brand like Federal Pacific, Stab-Lok, Sylvania, Challenger or Zinsco. Flickering lights and buzzing sounds are also warning signs.

faqs.q: Need help determining the correct load?
faqs.a: Call anytime and speak with a Master Electrician for free. We don't mind helping you get it all figured out, even if it's just a do-it-yourself type question.

faqs.q: Why hire an electrician instead of a handyman for a ceiling fan?
faqs.a: A ceiling fan is a moving electrical appliance that must be properly supported, safely wired and securely mounted. Many fan problems happen because the fan was installed on a standard light fixture box instead of a fan-rated box. When you hire ProLectric, you get a licensed electrician who knows the wiring, mounting, code requirements and fan-rated boxes.

faqs.q: How long does it take to get the power turned back on at a vacant home?
faqs.a: It usually takes 3 days: day one is the electrical inspection, day two the city inspection, and on day three the utility connects power. If repairs are needed to bring the home up to code, it could take longer.
